# Enums example (enum emulation in Go)

*Generated by qwen3.8-flash*

Read https://dizzy.zone/2024/01/26/Enums-in-Go.

The [`colors/colors.go`](colors/colors.go) package shows how to do enums in Go:
an unexported `color int` type with private `id` field.
Values are created only through the constructor functions `Red()`, `Green()`,
`Blue()`, `Unknown()`, so the set of allowed values is controlled by the package author.

## Running

```bash
cd enums
go run .
```

Expected output:

```
Red          id=1
Green        id=2
Blue         id=3
Unknown      id=0

Red().Equals(Red())   = true
Red().Equals(Blue())  = false
```

## Verification

```bash
cd enums
go vet ./...
go build ./...
```

## Structure

```
enums/
├── go.mod            # standalone enums module
├── main.go           # main package: demo of using colors.Color
└── colors/
    └── colors.go     # colors package: enum emulation
```
